acceptance: Reproduce PR #4508 lifecycle: an explicitly assigned Human/Ops reviewer with an exact-head approval must not be replaced, helper-claimed, or have its approval invalidated by a supervisor scan.

When an explicit Human/Ops reviewer is not a dispatchable worker, preserve it as the human review gate and fail closed or await that reviewer; never substitute an auto-worker merely to make assignment eligible.
Keep valid fallback/reassignment for non-protected reviewers and owner recovery unchanged, including existing bounded atomic owner/reviewer pair planning.

Cover mainline normalization, helper claim, reviewer-failure planning, owner-failure planning, review-approved reconciliation, and concurrent stale-CAS paths with positive and negative supervisor regressions.

Do not change account identity policy, quota groups, provider configuration, fallback ordering for non-Human/Ops agents, ai-status command semantics, canonical runtime state, live services, deployment, product tasks, or the source already delivered by PR #4508.

Use a clean governed worktree from current origin/dev and branch task/SUP-EXPLICIT-HUMAN-REVIEWER-PRESERVATION-OPERATOR-V8-20260802; deliver one scoped PR to dev with complete focused and relevant supervisor regressions, py_compile, evidence JSON parse, diff/trailer checks, exact-head Human/Ops review, and governed merge.

Merge this corrective PR before rebasing and reapproving PR #4508. Then revalidate #4508 without unrelated code changes. Rollback is a revert of this corrective merge; no runtime rollout is included in this task.
